vendor: Salesforce, Inc. (Tableau Software, LLC, a Salesforce company)
product_family: Tableau data visualization and business intelligence platform: Tableau Cloud (SaaS, formerly Tableau Online), Tableau Server (self-hosted), Tableau Desktop/Prep (client authoring tools), Tableau Public (free public sharing), Tableau Pulse and Tableau Agent (Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce-powered AI features), Tableau Next (next-gen AI analytics on Salesforce Data Cloud), and Tableau Government Cloud

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Report - Tableau. Product covered: Tableau Cloud. Reporting period May 1, 2025 - April 30, 2026, updated June 8, 2026. Provides assurance over control environments as they relate to the retrieval, storage, processing, and transfer of data, addressing security, availability, and confidentiality.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Certificate covers 18 services including Salesforce Services (First Party and Hyperforce), Data Cloud, MuleSoft, Heroku, and Tableau Cloud, explicitly: 'Applicable to the services branded as Tableau Cloud.' Reporting period March 10, 2026 - January 27, 2027, updated April 17, 2026.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 (cloud security controls)
certifications.proof_quote: Certificate scope includes Tableau Cloud and Tableau Next among 17 covered Salesforce services. Reporting period March 10, 2026 - January 27, 2027, updated April 17, 2026.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018:2019 (cloud PII protection)
certifications.proof_quote: Certificate applies to 'the services branded as Tableau Cloud' among 18 covered Salesforce offerings. Reporting period March 10, 2026 - January 27, 2027, updated April 18, 2026.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 42001:2023 - Salesforce AI Platform, Agentforce and Slack AI. Services covered explicitly list: Tableau Cloud - 'Applicable to the services branded as Tableau Cloud' and Tableau Next - 'Applicable to the services branded as Tableau Next, including the underlying Data Cloud, Tableau Semantics and Agentforce Services.' Valid September 30, 2025 - September 29, 2028.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Tableau Cloud is compliant with the Health Information and Portability Accountability Act (HIPAA). Whitepaper 'Tableau Cloud and the HIPAA Security Rule' available, updated December 2, 2022.

certifications.name: PCI DSS 4.0
certifications.proof_quote: Tableau Cloud meets Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) 4.0 compliance. PCI ASV Network Scan reports published per Hyperforce region (US East/West, Tokyo, Singapore, Sydney, Canada, EU/Germany), updated 2026-06-20.

certifications.name: TISAX (automotive-industry ISO 27001-based assessment)
certifications.proof_quote: TISAX Assessment Results covers 7 Salesforce services including Tableau Cloud explicitly. Scope ID S14843, Assessment ID AYSLF1-1.

certifications.name: UK Cyber Essentials / Cyber Essentials Plus
certifications.proof_quote: UK Cyber Essentials Certificate and UK Cyber Essentials Plus Certificate listed for Tableau Cloud, both updated 2026-06-22.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: FedRAMP authorization applies to the separate Tableau Government Cloud offering (Moderate, authorized 2021-01-25) and to Tableau Next/Agentforce/Data Cloud (High). The commercial Tableau Cloud product assessed here is not itself FedRAMP-authorized; government buyers must use the distinct Tableau Government Cloud SKU.

privacy.ai_training_note: For Tableau Agent / Tableau AI (Einstein/Agentforce Trust Layer) in Tableau Cloud: 'Neither customer data nor conversations sent to the Large Language Model (LLM) are saved to the LLM, and no customer data is ever used to train the model.' Zero-data-retention agreements are in place with third-party LLM providers, and admins can enable/disable AI features per user group or site. This applies to the current AI feature set; verify per-contract terms for legacy Tableau Server/Desktop deployments that predate these AI features, since offline/self-hosted installs do not send data to Salesforce-hosted LLMs at all.
privacy.data_region: Tableau Cloud runs on Salesforce Hyperforce infrastructure with regional options including US East/West, Canada, EU (Germany), UK, Japan, Singapore, and Australia; Tableau Server is self-hosted so data residency is entirely customer-controlled.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: All communication between users and Tableau Cloud is encrypted via SSL/TLS; Tableau Cloud supports TLS 1.2 and higher.

security.name: Infrastructure hosting
security.value: Tableau Cloud runs on Salesforce Hyperforce, Salesforce's own public-cloud infrastructure layer, with region-specific deployments audited individually (PCI ASV scans per region).

security.name: AI trust layer
security.value: AI features (Tableau Agent, Tableau Pulse) run on the Agentforce Trust Layer (formerly Einstein Trust Layer), which enforces zero data retention with third-party LLM providers and excludes customer data from model training.

security.name: Row-level / granular access control
security.value: Role-based access controls and row-level security restrict data visibility by user role and permission.

security.name: Vulnerability scanning
security.value: Recurring PCI Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) network scans published per Hyperforce region on the compliance site.

products.name: Tableau Cloud (formerly Tableau Online)
products.data_scope: Customer visualization data, connected data-source credentials, and end-user account data hosted on Salesforce Hyperforce. This is the product covered by essentially all certifications above (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, TISAX, C5, Cyber Essentials).
products.notes: Primary SaaS SKU and the one carrying the full compliance stack; the certifications in this assessment should not be assumed to extend to Tableau Server or Desktop.

products.name: Tableau Server
products.data_scope: Runs entirely on customer-managed infrastructure (on-prem or customer cloud account); data never leaves the customer's environment unless they choose to send it out.
products.notes: Security/compliance posture (encryption, access control, patching) is the customer's own responsibility, not covered by Tableau Cloud's SOC 2/ISO certificates.

products.name: Tableau Desktop / Tableau Prep
products.data_scope: Local application; connects to on-prem or cloud data sources chosen by the user.
products.notes: No SaaS-side data custody; compliance posture depends on where the user publishes/connects, not on Tableau Cloud's certifications.

products.name: Tableau Public
products.data_scope: Published workbooks and underlying data are publicly visible by design.
products.notes: Not intended for sensitive or confidential data; distinct free tier with a separate terms of use from Tableau Cloud.

products.name: Tableau Pulse / Tableau Agent (AI features)
products.category: Generative-AI analytics layer within Tableau Cloud
products.data_scope: Natural-language queries and underlying workbook data processed through the Agentforce Trust Layer and third-party LLMs under zero-retention agreements.
products.notes: Admin-controlled opt-in per user group or site; not used to train foundation models per vendor documentation.

products.name: Tableau Next
products.category: Next-generation AI analytics on Salesforce Data Cloud
products.data_scope: Built on Data Cloud and Agentforce Services rather than the classic Tableau Cloud stack.
products.notes: Separately named in the same ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001 certificates as Tableau Cloud, and is the product line that achieved FedRAMP High alongside Agentforce.

products.name: Tableau Government Cloud
products.data_scope: Isolated government community cloud boundary for federal/state customers.
products.notes: The distinct SKU that carries FedRAMP Moderate authorization (since 2021); the standard commercial Tableau Cloud product does not itself hold FedRAMP.

compare.pricing_model: Per-user subscription tiers (Viewer/Explorer/Creator) for Tableau Cloud and Server, sold directly or via Salesforce enterprise agreements; Tableau Public is free
compare.data_residency: Tableau Cloud offers multiple Hyperforce regions (US, Canada, EU/Germany, UK, Japan, Singapore, Australia); Tableau Server is fully customer-hosted so residency is entirely customer-determined

flags: Identity/scope note: Tableau's own trust.tableau.com now 301-redirects to trust.salesforce.com, and all certification proof was located on compliance.salesforce.com (Salesforce's shared compliance site) rather than a Tableau-only domain. Since Tableau Software LLC has been a wholly-owned Salesforce subsidiary since 2019 and Salesforce's compliance site explicitly names 'Tableau Cloud' and 'Tableau Next' as in-scope services on each certificate, this is treated as valid vendor-domain evidence, not a conflation with an unrelated company — but list the vendor as 'Salesforce (Tableau)' to avoid confusing buyers who expect an independent trust center.

Certification scope is Tableau Cloud (and Tableau Next) specifically. Tableau Server (self-hosted) and Tableau Desktop are NOT covered by these SOC 2/ISO/HIPAA/PCI certificates; do not imply blanket coverage across the whole product family.
FedRAMP is held only by the separate Tableau Government Cloud SKU (Moderate) and by Tableau Next/Agentforce (High), not by the standard commercial Tableau Cloud offering assessed here.
